epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local full-stack startup time from >10 minutes to <1 minute.
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root that starts the full stack.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for verification.

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml and health-check
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to create a single docker-compose setup and health-check, so that the full stack can be started and verified locally.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository without a local container setup, When the user runs docker-compose up, Then the backend and frontend start successfully.
Given the running stack, When a request is made to the health-check endpoint, Then a healthy status is returned and tests confirm the services are integrated.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Missing container orchestration and health probes.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease time to verify stack health locally from >5 mins to <10 seconds via health-check.

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of materials that are fully up to date from <80% to 100%.
requirements: R1: Implement update and delete UI for materials.

slices.title: Implement material update and delete UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing the UI updates for this epic, I want to add edit and delete actions, so that materials can be modified or removed directly from the interface.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system, When a user chooses to edit it from the UI, Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT API endpoint and the catalog is updated.
Given an existing material, When a user chooses to delete it, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API endpoint and it is removed from the view, with UI component tests verifying these interactions.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the UI time to delete or update a record from infinite (workaround needed) to <30 seconds.

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the rate of unauthorized access events from >0% to 0%.
requirements: R1: Implement user authentication and access blocking for unauthenticated users.

slices.title: Implement basic authentication blocking
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to block unauthenticated access, so that restricted materials are protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material, Then they are blocked.
Given a blocked attempt, When the user is redirected, Then they are prompted to log in, and integration tests verify the endpoints correctly return 401 Unauthorized.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthenticated request success rate from 100% to 0% for protected routes.
